# refs

<!-- ops:identity start — generated by ops-docs; edit identity.toml -->
A facet (refs/about) that lets a node carry identifiers drawn from vocabularies, with a CURIE grammar parsed against a pinned Bioregistry release and each identifier optionally pinned to a vocabulary release. Python and TypeScript over one shared format, layered above nodes and below the domain profiles. refs only parses, validates and records identifiers; resolving one is quarry's job.
<!-- ops:identity end -->

## Setup

`just setup` links the sibling `nodes` checkout (`../nodes`) that the packages depend on.
The Python and TypeScript packages are added in later changes; until then a checkout holds
only the front door.

## Usage

Nothing runs yet. `just check` runs the repository checks; `just test` runs the suite,
which is empty until the packages land.

## Layout

- `tools/`: files vendored from ops (see `tools/README.md`).
- `.githooks/`: the pre-commit and pre-push hooks.

## Consumers

None yet. Planned: quarry and lit.
